title: Runtime run
responsibility: Presents one side of recorded behavior by scenario, state and artifact.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.shown
inputs.description: Grouped results and scenario titles. Overall passes only when groups exist and every group passes on the chosen side.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.side
inputs.description: Required before or after, selecting outcomes and cells. Only after displays difference paths.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.role
inputs.description: Required descriptive badge for this side.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.lost
inputs.description: Required failure flag forwarded so unread artifacts are not left pending.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.refusals
inputs.description: Required hash-to-refusal map. Each artifact uses its capture hash or the empty-string key when no hash exists.

inputs.name: RuntimeRun.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier forwarded to artifact case rendering.

outputs.name: RuntimeRun
outputs.description: Run status, state headings and result artifacts with Passed/Failed/Not recorded labels. After-side results list differences. Empty groups do not count as passing.
